headline: Storm Shifts North: Nevish Line Erupts as Weathered Expanse Bleeds On
war_summary: Since our last edition the storm has shifted north. The Nevish Line, whose flags had been still since before dawn, has broken out afresh — eight flag events inside two hours, losses of better than six hundred Colonials and near five hundred Wardens in the same span, with Blackcoat Way the busiest post on that front. Weathered Expanse grows no quieter: more than seven hundred Colonial and eleven hundred Warden casualties in two hours, ten further flag events in the same span, and two of its nine strongpoints still no-man's-land. Gutter, yesterday's busiest flag market, has fallen nearly silent, two events only in the past two hours against fifty-seven on the day. Palantine Berm's flags have paused since mid-morning, though its casualty rolls keep climbing. Callahans Passage, transferless still, has surged again toward a thousand Colonial losses in the latest hour, a day's toll near twenty thousand. Linn Mercy bleeds hard without moving a flag since early morning, while Marban Hollow stirs once more and Stlican Shelf and Godcrofts simmer low. The war stands in its 646th day; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize.
